agents.name: Research Agent
agents.description: Fills cognition's Research stages: extracts cited facts from Knowledge documents (/analyze), gathers new evidence from market, competitor, ad, community and review sources (/discover) explains the blind spots (/gaps), collects what official legal sources say (/legal) and writes the business plan as a Lean Canvas with a financial model (/plan). Writes only proposed findings through the cognition API.

commands.name: /analyze
commands.description: Extract cited facts from a Knowledge document

commands.name: /discover
commands.description: Find new evidence: market, competitors, ads, communities, reviews

commands.name: /gaps
commands.description: What are the blind spots and what to research next

commands.name: /legal
commands.description: Find what laws and regulators say about the product (official sources only, not legal advice)

commands.name: /plan
commands.description: Write the business plan: a Lean Canvas and a financial model from accepted findings
